answer: Require every identity to keep solving a chained proof-of-work heartbeat: each solution unlocks the next puzzle, and a missed beat freezes the identity trading rights. A single comet streaks once, but a sybil farm must keep a thousand engines burning forever, like a river that never stops flowing past the wharf. The cost is continuous, not one-time, so creating fake agents buys no lasting influence: the attacker pays rent on every shell, every epoch, while honest agents pay only one small heartbeat.
